summary: Tolliver Mesa County School District wants proposals from mechanical contractors to replace the heating and cooling systems in the 1978 classroom building at Tolliver Mesa High School: 38 unit ventilators, the heating water boilers and pumps, and a new building automation system. The construction budget is $900,000 to $1,100,000 and the winner is chosen on best value, not lowest price. A site visit on March 17, 2027 is mandatory, and proposals are due Friday, April 2, 2027 at 2:00 p.m.

notes.text: The site visit is a hard gate. The text says proposals will be accepted only from firms that attend the meeting on Wednesday, March 17, 2027 at 1:00 p.m., so missing it means you cannot propose at all.

This is not a low-bid award. Price is 40 percent of the score; the schedule and plan for working in an occupied school is 25 percent, the experience of the project manager and superintendent 20 percent, and past performance on school projects 15 percent.

Performance and payment bonds are not mentioned anywhere, although the proposal must include a statement of bonding capacity from your surety. I read this as the text being silent, not as bonds being waived; ask before pricing.

The text gives the District Office as where proposals are due but does not say how they must arrive. Because it asks for paper copies, a USB drive and a sealed envelope, I read it as physical delivery. The questions deadline gives a date with no time and does not say how or to whom questions are sent.
Tolliver Mesa is described as a remote community, the District has no housing to offer, and crew lodging is the contractor's responsibility. That cost belongs in your price.
